preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 10 for N, M in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) if line.strip() and line.split()[0] == str(N))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of intersections N is between 2 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= M <= N * (N - 1) // 2 for N, M in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) if line.strip() and line.split()[0] == str(N))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of roads M is between 1 and N*(N-1)/2 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Ai <= N and 1 <= Bi <= N and Ai != Bi and 1 <= Ci <= 10 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct intersections Ai and Bi (1 ≤ Ai, Bi ≤ N, Ai ≠ Bi) with a length Ci between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(Ai != Aj or Bi != Bj for i in range(len(roads)) for j in range(i + 1, len(roads)) if (Ai, Bi) != (Aj, Bj))
preconditions.description: No duplicate roads exist (if i ≠ j and Ai = Aj, then Bi ≠ Bj).

preconditions.expression: all(any(Ai == 1 and Bi == N or Ai == N and Bi == 1 for Ai, Bi, Ci in roads) or any(Ai == 1 and Bi == k or Ai == k and Bi == 1 for k in range(2, N) for Ai, Bi, Ci in roads) or any(Ai == k and Bi == N or Ai == N and Bi == k for k in range(2, N) for Ai, Bi, Ci in roads))
preconditions.description: There is at least one path from intersection 1 (Tomya's house) to intersection N (Ciel's restaurant).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip() == str(count_shortest_paths(N, roads)) for N, M, roads in parse_test_cases(stdin))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the number of shortest paths from intersection 1 to intersection N, where roads is the list of (Ai, Bi, Ci) tuples.
